verdict: SUCCESS — ALL MIGRATIONS AND VERIFICATIONS PASSED
verdict_justification: All three authorized migrations (c742f9a1e0b5, e4b19082a5c1, and f3a9082b1c42) executed cleanly in a single atomic transaction without error. The live database revision advanced from 1273f18b72a2 to f3a9082b1c42. Standard Row Level Security is active across all eight public tables. API roles anon and authenticated have zero table privileges and zero sequence privileges. Future default privileges for creator role postgres in schema public exclude API roles. All ten post-migration catalog checks passed. All 40,416 rows across domain tables remain completely intact with 100% data fidelity.

scope: Executing live Supabase migration using alembic upgrade head
Applying three reviewed migrations: c742f9a1e0b5, e4b19082a5c1, f3a9082b1c42
Executing ten read-only post-migration catalog checks
Authoring execution reports in Markdown and JSON

sequence.description: enable standard rls on eight public tables
harden least privilege grants on public tables and sequences

check_2_table_existence.query: SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename IN ('ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens') ORDER BY tablename;

check_3_rls_activation.query: SELECT c.relname, c.relrowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('machines', 'sensor_readings', 'alembic_version', 'maintenance_history', 'alerts', 'tickets', 'ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens') ORDER BY c.relname;

check_4_force_rls_invariance.query: SELECT c.relname, c.relforcerowsecurity FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('machines', 'sensor_readings', 'alembic_version', 'maintenance_history', 'alerts', 'tickets', 'ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens') ORDER BY c.relname;

check_5_zero_policies.query: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = p.polrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('machines', 'sensor_readings', 'alembic_version', 'maintenance_history', 'alerts', 'tickets', 'ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens');

check_6_table_grants_revocation.query: SELECT grantee, table_name, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('machines', 'sensor_readings', 'alembic_version', 'maintenance_history', 'alerts', 'tickets', 'ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens') AND grantee IN ('anon', 'authenticated');

check_7_sequence_grants_revocation.query: SELECT grantee, object_name, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_usage_grants WHERE object_schema = 'public' AND object_name IN ('sensor_readings_id_seq', 'maintenance_history_id_seq') AND grantee IN ('anon', 'authenticated');

check_8_retained_privileges.expected: postgres and service_role retain full table privileges across all 8 tables
check_8_retained_privileges.query: SELECT grantee, table_name, count(privilege_type) as priv_count FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('machines', 'sensor_readings', 'alembic_version', 'maintenance_history', 'alerts', 'tickets', 'ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens') AND grantee IN ('postgres', 'service_role') GROUP BY grantee, table_name ORDER BY table_name, grantee;

check_9_default_privileges.expected: Default ACLs exist for 'r' and 'S' for postgres in public with zero anon/authenticated grants
check_9_default_privileges.query: SELECT d.defaclobjtype, d.defaclacl::text FROM pg_default_acl d JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = d.defaclnamespace WHERE pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) = 'postgres' AND n.nspname = 'public' AND d.defaclobjtype IN ('r', 'S');

check_10_ownership_invariance.expected: All 10 tables and sequences owned by postgres
check_10_ownership_invariance.query: SELECT c.relname, r.rolname as owner, c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid = c.relowner WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname IN ('machines', 'sensor_readings', 'alembic_version', 'maintenance_history', 'alerts', 'tickets', 'ticket_proposals', 'consumed_tokens', 'sensor_readings_id_seq', 'maintenance_history_id_seq') ORDER BY c.relname;

architectural_notes.supabase_admin_limitation: Default privileges hardened for role postgres only. All future schema objects must be deployed via Alembic executing as postgres.
architectural_notes.service_role_usage: service_role preserves administrative access (arwdDxtm) for trusted backend server-to-server operations.
architectural_notes.downgrade_policy: Alembic downgrade fails closed via NotImplementedError by design.
